top_news.title: trajectory-judge: What Outcome-Only LLM Judges Miss on Agent Trajectories
top_news.dek: Outcome-only evaluation fails to detect agent errors that result in correct final answers but follow flawed execution paths.
top_news.brief: Researchers demonstrate that standard LLM evaluation, which only checks final outputs, misses 'silent' failures where agents reach the correct result through incorrect tool usage. By using a deterministic environment with fault injection, the study highlights the need for process-aware evaluation to ensure agent reliability.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the difference between outcome-only and process-aware evaluation paths.

top_news.title: datasette-mcp 0.2
top_news.dek: Datasette-mcp 0.2 adds an MCP server endpoint to any Datasette instance, improving model compatibility.
top_news.brief: The update introduces a /-/mcp endpoint, allowing Datasette instances to function as Model Context Protocol servers. It also updates the SQL execution output to return an array of objects rather than arrays, helping LLMs better map data to column names.
top_news.image_alt: Datasette logo and MCP protocol icon.

top_news.title: Mistral now trains on user input by default, except on enterprise tier
top_news.dek: Mistral has updated its data policy to include user inputs in model training by default for non-enterprise users.
top_news.brief: Users on standard Mistral tiers are now opted into data training by default. Enterprise customers remain exempt from this policy, ensuring their input and output data are not used for model improvement. Users seeking to opt out of data collection must check their specific account settings or contact support for guidance on data privacy configurations.
top_news.image_alt: Mistral AI logo and help center interface

top_news.title: US military adds ChatGPT and Grok to AI platform GenAI.mil
top_news.dek: The US Department of Defense has integrated OpenAI's ChatGPT Mil and xAI's Grok for Government into its GenAI.mil platform.
top_news.brief: Previously limited to Google Gemini, the Pentagon's GenAI.mil platform now supports additional models to serve its 1.7 million users. ChatGPT Mil is primarily focused on administrative, logistical, and planning tasks. The expansion aims to provide military personnel with a broader suite of AI tools for internal operations.
top_news.image_alt: US Department of Defense GenAI.mil platform interface

top_news.title: Bye Bye Perspective API: Lessons for Measurement Infrastructure in NLP, CSS and LLM Evaluation
top_news.dek: A new paper examines the challenges of building and governing measurement infrastructure for NLP, following the sunsetting of the Perspective API.
top_news.brief: The research analyzes the lifecycle of measurement tools like the Perspective API, offering lessons for future infrastructure in content moderation and LLM evaluation. It highlights the technical and governance hurdles involved in maintaining long-term, reliable measurement systems for language models.

primary.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs) under strict resource constraints.
